source_basis.copyright_boundary: Do not copy article media, prompts, scripts, or private project data. Extract workflow mechanisms only.

workflow.reuse_rule: Every reused asset is referenced by asset_id and SHA-256; no silent regeneration of an already approved asset.

workflow.rule: Local repair creates a child branch and preserves the parent; it never clones an entire episode to repair one shot.
Use explicit blocking for multi-actor or special-angle shots; text-only placement is marked UNKNOWN, not assumed correct.
Agnes may be used for isolated trials or controlled takes; provider completion never equals director PASS.
Only repeated, hash-backed failure patterns become experience; a single opinion does not rewrite routing.

quality_invariants: One shot has one primary dramatic action or dialogue beat.
Long actions are split at preparation, peak/impact, and recovery boundaries.
Character, wardrobe, scene, prop, spatial blocking, and camera references are explicit.
A failed child branch preserves the parent and its evidence.
Free Zone research renders remain candidates until explicit hash-bound admission.
Episode Dynamic Plan binds story spine and beats to Shot Core without adding a scheduler.
Content state R0-R5 is monotonic within one Production Run and independent from technical/provider route.
Pacing ratios are diagnostic evidence only; only CONTENT_FAILURE may authorize content degradation.

Story material is not the finished video medium. medium_lock must be signed CHARACTER_PERFORMANCE, LIVE_ACTION_DRAMA, or UI_ANIMATION before any image or video provider call; unsigned lock or chat-UI language in a non-UI medium is BLOCKED.

execution_surfaces.principle: The Infinite Canvas is the human-facing creative and review surface, never the sole execution dependency for an agent running on the local computer.
local_execution_first: Use the existing local media runner for provider submission, durable video_id recovery, download, SHA-256 receipt and retry handling.
Use local asset paths, manifests, ffprobe and FFmpeg for media validation, assembly, subtitles and audio checks.
Use the browser only to inspect or verify the user-facing canvas, deployed configuration and visual result; do not require a browser button click to resume an already-defined local production task.
execution_surfaces.canvas_writeback: After a local action has an artifact or a concrete blocked/error receipt, write a compact asset, take, evidence or Decision Record reference back to the existing canvas. The canvas remains the human-readable branch and choice surface.
execution_surfaces.fallback: If the canvas website, browser session or local Canvas Agent is unavailable, continue only safe local execution and evidence collection. Do not pretend the canvas was updated; record CANVAS_WRITEBACK_PENDING and reconcile when the surface recovers.
execution_surfaces.free_zone: Free Zone may use isolated browser sessions and local probes for discovery. Controlled production uses the same local substrate but keeps its existing asset, review and release gates.

demand_entrypoint.purpose: route user demand through the existing state machine and invoke safe local stages automatically
demand_entrypoint.provider_calls: remain behind the admitted request boundary and reuse the existing provider runner
